Matthew Good and His Band with I Mother Earth

Tue, Dec 15 2026, 7:30 - 10:30pm
Event type(s)
CN Centre Event
CN Centre Event type(s)
Special Event
Location

CN Centre

Don’t miss your chance to see a pair of legendary Canadian rock bands! Matthew Good and His Band with I Mother Earth are bringing the spirit of the 90s to the CN Centre on Tuesday, December 15, 2026.

Matthew Good is a multi-platinum selling Canadian recording artist who began his career as the frontman for the Matthew Good Band, of the most successful Canadian alternative rock bands during the 1990s and early 2000s.

A staple among 90s Canadian alternative rock, I Mother Earth when from basement jam sessions to one of the top 150 best-selling Canadian artists and top 40 best-selling Canadian bands in Canada from 1996 and 2016.

Tickets available only at TicketsNorth and online at ticketsnorth.ca.
